prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1391; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I suppose that's fine. [Claimant name].

Q: Thank you. Where were you when the collision occurred?

A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store in Houston, Texas, driving slowly toward an open spot near the entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before impact?

A: I had just signaled and started to turn into the space. The other vehicle came backing out of the spot next to it, and it didn't stop.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Maybe five or ten miles an hour. It was a parking lot, so nobody's really going fast.

Q: Did you have a chance to brake?

A: I did. I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but the other car's rear bumper caught my front driver's side corner anyway.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, always.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: No. It was a low-speed impact. The jolt was enough to throw me forward and back against the seat.

Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?

A: Not right away. I felt it in my lower back about an hour later, sitting in my car. It's a sharp ache that gets worse when I bend or sit too long.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same week. They diagnosed a lumbar strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've missed some work because of it, and I'm still doing the exercises my therapist gave me. I'd like this resolved so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
